about: Real recordings and real measurements of real human brains. Each carries its own source, licence and citation, because they differ.

action-potential.title: One human neuron firing
action-potential.citation: Whole cell current clamp from human cortical tissue, DANDI dandiset 000293.
action-potential.subject: human cortical neuron

eeg-alpha.title: A rhythm across the back of one head
eeg-alpha.citation: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database, subject 1, runs 1 and 2. Goldberger et al., Circulation 101:e215 (2000); Schalk et al., IEEE TBME 51:1034 (2004).

eeg-bands.title: The five rhythms, from one recording
eeg-bands.citation: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database, subject 1, runs 1 and 2. Goldberger et al., Circulation 101:e215 (2000); Schalk et al., IEEE TBME 51:1034 (2004).
eeg-bands.method: Fourth order Butterworth band pass, applied forwards and backwards so no band is shifted in time against another. Power is the integral of Welch's spectrum over each band.

bands.name: delta
bands.note: Deep sleep, and the slowest thing a scalp can hear.

bands.name: theta
bands.note: Drowsiness and navigation. Sets the windows the faster rhythms are allowed to matter in.

bands.name: alpha
bands.note: The idling rhythm of the back of the head. Present with the eyes closed, gone when they open.

bands.name: gamma
bands.note: Fast enough that a single spike can be early or late within one cycle.

eeg-topography.title: Where each rhythm sits on the head
eeg-topography.citation: PhysioNet EEG Motor Movement/Imagery Database, subject 1, runs 1 and 2, all 64 channels. Electrode coordinates are the standard 10-05 template (MNE), not this person's head.
eeg-topography.method: Welch spectrum per electrode over 50 seconds; each band's share of that electrode's own 1 to 45 Hz power, so a site with a big signal cannot dominate every band.

myelin-lifespan.title: Myelin across adult life
myelin-lifespan.citation: Faizy TD, Kumar D, Broocks G, et al. Age-related measures of the human brain's white matter myelin. Sci Rep 8, 14991 (2018). doi.org/10.1038/s41598-018-33112-8
